# L1: A and B are the same size and overlap by 0.7 mm in x. B is later in the order (equal
# area, higher index) so B moves. Lattice step 0.25 mm without a grid: the first free spot is
# three steps right, 12.05. With a 1 mm grid B lands on 12.
board 0 0 40 30
cell A 10 10 1 0.5 free
cell B 11.3 10 1 0.5 free
expect B_no_grid 12.05 10
expect B_grid_1 12 10
